# splunkctl hec

Manage HTTP Event Collector tokens.

## hec create

Create a new HEC token.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl hec create [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | - | Token name. [required] |
| `--index` | text | - | Default index. |
| `--indexes` | text | - | Allowed indexes (comma-separated). |
| `--sourcetype` | text | - | Default source type. |
| `--set` | text | - | KEY=VALUE (e.g. useACK=1). |

## hec delete

Delete a HEC token.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl hec delete [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## hec disable

Disable a HEC token.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl hec disable [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## hec enable

Enable a HEC token.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl hec enable [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## hec get

Get HEC token details.

```text
splunkctl hec get [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## hec list

List HEC tokens.

```text
splunkctl hec list [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## hec send

Send one event through a HEC token.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl hec send [OPTIONS] NAME EVENT
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--index` | text | - | Target index. |
| `--sourcetype` | text | - | Source type. |

## hec settings

Show or toggle global HEC settings.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl hec settings [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--enable` | flag | - | Enable HEC globally. |
| `--disable` | flag | - | Disable HEC globally. |
